category: Protect All Forms of Code from Unauthorized Access and Tampering (PS)
subcategory_text: Restrict access to code modification and submission tools (e.g., source-control UIs, command-line tools) to authorised users and log all access.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: AC-2, AU-2, AU-3
implementation_examples: Restrict the use of git-push and merge operations to authorised roles
Log and alert on push events from outside approved locations
Use signed commits from approved developer keys
assessment_objectives: Determine whether code-submission tools are access-controlled.
Determine whether access events are logged and audited.
